name: Panhandle Eastern Tuscola East Replacement Project
monitor_reason: length: replacement project, no net new pipe. The 2007 FERC notice says new pipe replaces 29.4 miles of existing pipelines (for example 6.7 miles of 20-inch replaced by 36-inch, 1.9 miles of 36-inch replaced by 20-inch) in Illinois and Indiana to restore long-haul capacity east from Tuscola toward Michigan. The new pipe lies largely in existing corridors and the old pipe is retired or reused, so the addition is well under the 25 km rule. Not an existing-row alias either: P0239 is the parent system. No expansion row is warranted.
researcher_notes: A Federal Register notice from March 2007 announces the FERC environmental assessment for docket CP06-428. It describes replacement of existing Panhandle pipe with larger or smaller diameter pipe. It states no net new pipe length. The project is more than a decade old and its current status was not checked. Not staged as a new row. Parent system is P0239 Panhandle Eastern Gas Pipeline.
